title: The focus shortcut on a panel cannot be changed if it is assigned to a panel on a currently unplugged monitor
line: Giving a panel a focus shortcut another panel already uses now keeps Panel Settings open, and Continue moves the shortcut to it.
explanation: The bug is not specific to unplugged monitors: any focus shortcut that another panel already uses shows KeySequenceItem's 'Found Conflict' dialog. When that dialog took focus, PanelConfigView::focusVisibilityCheck() treated it as an unrelated window and hid Panel Settings, which deletes it together with the shortcut field, so Continue reached a destroyed recorder and nothing changed. The plasma-workspace change keeps the settings open when the newly focused window is transient for them; the kdeclarative change (the open MR for bug 519304) gives the conflict dialog that transient parent.

commits.message:
shell/panelconfigview: don't close for the shortcut conflict dialog

When the "Found Conflict" dialog took focus, Panel Settings hid itself
and destroyed the shortcut field, so Continue changed nothing. Don't
hide when the focused window is a dialog transient for the settings.

BUG: 516649

KeySequenceItem: make the conflict dialog block its window

The shortcut conflict dialog had no parent window, so its modality
blocked nothing and the settings window could close under it. Make it
and the error dialog transient for the window the shortcut field is in.

BUG: 519304
BUG: 516649

patches.diff:
From 8dd910c49218e688c4b7781cdeecb596612cad9f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:14:14 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] shell/panelconfigview: don't close for the shortcut conflict
 dialog

When the "Found Conflict" dialog took focus, Panel Settings hid itself
and destroyed the shortcut field, so Continue changed nothing. Don't
hide when the focused window is a dialog transient for the settings.

BUG: 516649
---
 shell/panelconfigview.cpp | 5 +++++
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+)

diff --git a/shell/panelconfigview.cpp b/shell/panelconfigview.cpp
index 7af58da0c3..6deb8b9b06 100644
--- a/shell/panelconfigview.cpp
+++ b/shell/panelconfigview.cpp
@@ -368,6 +368,11 @@ void PanelConfigView::focusVisibilityCheck(QWindow *focusWindow)
     if (focusWindow == this || (m_panelRulerView && focusWindow == m_panelRulerView.get())) {
         return;
     }
+    // Do not hide if the focus is on a dialog of the settings, such as the
+    // shortcut conflict warning
+    if (focusWindow->transientParent() == this) {
+        return;
+    }
 
     // Do not hide if the focus is on PopupPlasmaWindows opened by the
     // panel, e.g. the settings popup that appear on applet hover.
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: pressing Meta+Alt+J (already the top panel's) in the bottom panel's settings shows 'Found Conflict' and Panel Settings disappears
With the fix: same step, Panel Settings stays open (dimmed) behind 'Found Conflict'
Master: after Continue there are no settings left and the shortcut stays on the top panel
With the fix: after Continue the bottom panel's Focus shortcut shows Meta+Alt+J

review.text: Solid two-repo fix addressing the real cause: kdeclarative sets the transient parent on KeySequenceHelper's WindowModal conflict and error dialogs, and plasma-workspace keeps PanelConfigView open when focus moves to a transient child window so clicking Continue reaches the live shortcut recorder and reassigns the shortcut. Both patches are minimal and safe against null or destroyed windows, and the screenshots and kglobalshortcutsrc checks confirm the fix.

reviews.text: Solid two-repo fix addressing the real cause: kdeclarative sets the transient parent on KeySequenceHelper's WindowModal conflict and error dialogs, and plasma-workspace keeps PanelConfigView open when focus moves to a transient child window so clicking Continue reaches the live shortcut recorder and reassigns the shortcut. Both patches are minimal and safe against null or destroyed windows, and the screenshots and kglobalshortcutsrc checks confirm the fix.

Correct diagnosis: the bug isn't about unplugged monitors. The 'Found Conflict' dialog takes focus, PanelConfigView::focusVisibilityCheck() treats it as foreign and hides and destroys Panel Settings, so Continue reaches a dead recorder. The fix has two parts, both needed: KeySequenceHelper makes its question and error dialogs transient for the recorder's window (winId() then setTransientParent, the usual pattern, which also makes WindowModal actually block), and the panel config view ignores focus moving to a window transient for itself. The shots and verify notes show Panel Settings staying open behind the dialog, Continue moving Meta+Alt+J, and the old panel's entry becoming none (the live Applet picks this up through globalShortcutChanged, so its saved config follows). Cancel and focus moving to another app still behave correctly. Nits: the after test used two live panels rather than a disabled output (the mechanism is the same), and the plasma-workspace commit only works once the kdeclarative change ships, which the MR text should mention.
